tickerText: [TENNIS] The Nitto ATP Finals draw in Turin goes live Thursday at noon CET for Zverev, Alcaraz and the full eight-man field, while Dabrowski and Stefani moved to 2-0 in WTA Finals doubles at Indian Wells with a match-tiebreak win over Guo and Mladenovic • [SQUASH] PSA Silver play continues at the Pittsburgh Open through November 15 as Shanghai prepares for the season-ending China Open Gold from November 17, headlined by Mostafa Asal and Amina Orfi • [BADMINTON] An Se-young's three-set Korea Open final win over Akane Yamaguchi tied her for 11 titles in 2026, while Victor Lai became Canada's first men's champion at the Yeosu Super 500 • [PICKLEBALL] Challenger Showdown winners locked in PPA Tour contracts in Texas and the 1,000-point Proton Daytona Beach Open opens qualifying November 17 ahead of $1M-plus payout week in Holly Hill • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Contender Istanbul's main draw opens November 12 after qualifiers such as Quadri Aruna advanced, with No. 1 Anders Lind and Honoka Hashimoto leading last-32 singles fields at Ata Sporları Merkezi

newsItems.title: Turin Draw Day
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 Nitto ATP Finals group draw takes place Thursday at noon CET in Turin, setting round-robin paths for Zverev, Alcaraz and six rivals before indoor play begins November 15.

newsItems.title: An Ties Her Mark
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young beat Akane Yamaguchi 21-12, 15-21, 21-16 in Yeosu to win the YEOSU VICTOR Korea Open and match her own 11-title season best from 2025.

newsItems.title: Daytona Open Next
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Proton Daytona Beach Open runs November 16–22 at Pictona, an Open-tier stop worth 1,000 ranking points and more than $1 million in total payouts.

newsItems.title: Istanbul Last 32
newsItems.excerpt: Singles main-draw play begins at WTT Contender Istanbul on November 12, where top seeds Anders Lind and Honoka Hashimoto lead 24-player draws chasing $100,000 in prize money.
